# JointBrex (jointbrex.onrender.com)

> jointbrex.onrender.com is an independent reader information site about JointBrex, a daily capsule dietary supplement. It is not the manufacturer or seller and does not take orders.

## Product facts (from the seller's published page and supplied photos)
- Form: capsule, 60-count bottle as pictured; seller's directions: one capsule daily
- Per capsule: turmeric root extract 4:1 75 mg; turmeric extract 95% curcuminoids 30 mg; coleus forskohlii extract 15 mg; black pepper fruit extract (BioPerine) 5 mg; other ingredients microcrystalline cellulose, gelatin, magnesium stearate
- The capsule contains gelatin (animal-derived), so it is not vegetarian
- Packages: 2 bottles $79 each ($158 plus $9.99 shipping), 3 bottles $69 each ($207, free shipping), 6 bottles $49 each ($294, free shipping); seller lists 60, 90 and 180 day supplies
- 60-day money-back guarantee; contact support within 60 days; empty bottles accepted
- Not a treatment for arthritis, injuries or any disease; black pepper extract can raise levels of some medicines, turmeric may add to blood thinners and coleus can lower blood pressure
